svg.aria-label: On demand only: Benchmarks run on demand, never from a timer. Every published run lands on the live benchmark site. Benchmark site: The latest run is the headline. The history lists all runs. Long reference: Skill sets, agent roles, sprint gates and release highlights are in docs/REFERENCE.md. Method and limits: In BENCHMARK-GUIDE.md
